notes: Official-source RAG seed for the canonical TR_E_VISA product. The product covers Türkiye e-Visa applications for tourism or trade only; eligibility and visa outcomes must be derived from the live official portal rather than represented as applicant choices.

chunks.title: TR_E_VISA purpose and application channel
chunks.content: TR_E_VISA is the VIZA product for the Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Foreign Affairs e-Visa application at https://evisa.gov.tr/en/apply/. The official e-Visa is valid only for tourism or trade. Work, study, residence and other purposes require a Turkish embassy or consulate route and are outside this product. Every traveller, including a child or infant, requires an individual e-Visa. Official overview: https://evisa.gov.tr/en/tour/.

chunks.title: Eligibility and visa outcomes are nationality-derived
chunks.content: The live official portal determines eligibility, single- or multiple-entry entitlement, e-Visa validity period, permitted duration of stay, fee and any additional conditions from the applicant's country or region of travel document and intended arrival date. These outcomes are not applicant-selectable form answers and VIZA must not hard-code or promise them. Re-evaluate them against the live portal for every application. Official eligibility and entry guidance: https://evisa.gov.tr/en/info/who-is-eligible-for-e-visa/ and https://evisa.gov.tr/en/info/can-i-obtain-multiple-entry-e-visa/.

chunks.title: Passport and conditional supporting-document rules
chunks.content: The traveller must carry a passport or substitute travel document whose expiry is at least 60 days beyond the permitted visa stay or other authorised stay. Depending on travel-document nationality, the official portal may also require a valid visa or residence permit from a named supporting country or region. The required supporting-document type, issuing jurisdiction and validity rules are portal-derived conditions, not free choices. The supporting visa or residence permit is carried for travel; the official e-Visa form records its details and does not request a file upload. Official guidance: https://evisa.gov.tr/en/info/what-do-i-need-for-e-visa-application/ and https://www.evisa.gov.tr/en/info/what-are-the-criteria-for-the-validity-of-my-supporting-document-visa-or-residence-permit-from-schengen-or-oecd-member-countries/.

chunks.title: Approval does not guarantee admission
chunks.content: An approved e-Visa does not guarantee entry. Passport-control officers make the final admission decision and can verify the e-Visa electronically. The traveller should retain access to the e-Visa and carry every passport and conditional supporting document used for the application.

chunks.title: Official form channel and audited scope
chunks.content: The audited TR_E_VISA answer schema follows the official Türkiye e-Visa application flow documented by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs application guide at https://www.evisa.gov.tr/assets/files/guide_en.pdf and the live application at https://evisa.gov.tr/en/apply/. It covers the individual tourism-or-trade e-Visa form only. It does not model family/group administration, account credentials, session data, CAPTCHA, payment-card data or consular visa forms as applicant answers.

chunks.title: Applicant answers collected by TR_E_VISA
chunks.content: Collect the travel-document country or region and intended arrival date first so the official rules can be derived. Collect the personal, parent-name, birth, passport or travel-document, email, telephone and residential-address fields shown by the official individual application. When the derived eligibility rules require a supporting visa or residence permit, collect only the supporting-document details requested by the official form. Tourism/trade is the product scope; it is not a separate purpose question in this application schema. Use the exact official closed-list values and do not add generic itinerary, accommodation, employment, funds, insurance or invitation questions unless the live official form introduces them.

chunks.title: Derived conditions and conditional panels
chunks.content: After travel-document country or region and arrival date are selected, display the official eligibility conditions as derived guidance. Entry count, validity period, permitted stay and fee are read-only outcomes, never radio buttons or other applicant choices. Show one conditional supporting-document panel only when the official rule requires it, with the rule-derived document type and issuer context. Do not create a file field: this branch records supporting-document data, while the traveller carries the original supporting document.

chunks.title: Submission workflow guardrails
chunks.content: Keep eligibility derivation, applicant answers, email verification, payment and the issued e-Visa as separate workflow states. The confirmation email and payment window are operational workflow data, not form questions. VIZA manages the official-portal session and payment; applicant-facing intake must not ask for portal credentials, verification tokens or official-fee card details.

chunks.title: Standard passport identity-field answer rules
chunks.content: Standard-answer identity fields must be answered from the applicant's passport biodata page, official identity document, MRZ where that field is encoded, or the official form's dropdown options. This applies to passport number, name, date of birth, sex, nationality, issuing country, issue date, expiry date, issuing authority, place of issue, and passport/document type. Treat issuing country, place of issue, and issuing authority as distinct fields and never substitute one for another. Place of issue / 签发地点 asks for the location recorded on the passport or required by the official form, such as a city, province, municipality, or a country selected from an official country-only dropdown; copy the passport's Place of issue value when present, and enter a country only when the form explicitly asks for Country of issue / Issuing country or provides a country-only selector. Issuing authority / 签发机关 asks for the organization printed under Authority / Issuing authority. For Chinese ordinary passports, National Immigration Administration, PRC / 中华人民共和国国家移民管理局 and MPS Exit & Entry Administration / 公安部出入境管理局 are issuing-authority examples only and must never be suggested as place-of-issue answers. Do not infer either field from the pickup city, residence city, application country, or travel destination. If the passport prints a different value for the requested field, use that exact field value. For passport type, select Ordinary / Regular / Normal only for ordinary personal passports; select Diplomatic, Official, Service, Special, Travel document, Refugee, or Other only when the document explicitly indicates that type. Official sources reviewed for this standard field rule include China National Immigration Administration certificate-issuing-authority notices and the Passport Law of the People's Republic of China; the passport biodata page and the destination's official field wording remain the final sources for the applicant's individual answer.

chunks.title: TR_E_VISA official-source answer norms
chunks.content: Use the exact label and value emitted by the live official portal for closed-list fields. Copy identity and travel-document answers from the passport or travel document, and copy any conditional supporting-document answer from that document. Do not infer an answer from nationality when the form asks for a different field. The official sources reviewed for this schema are https://evisa.gov.tr/en/apply/, https://evisa.gov.tr/en/tour/, https://www.evisa.gov.tr/assets/files/guide_en.pdf, https://evisa.gov.tr/en/info/who-is-eligible-for-e-visa/, https://evisa.gov.tr/en/info/can-i-obtain-multiple-entry-e-visa/ and https://evisa.gov.tr/en/info/what-do-i-need-for-e-visa-application/. The live form and the applicant's documents control if they differ from cached guidance.
